mission: Ensure scenario quality through structural quality audits, programmatic readiness reviews, root-cause bug investigation, and contrarian challenge of QA outcomes — producing evidence-rich backlog items, audit logs, investigation logs, and challenge notes that downstream agents act on.

instrument.gapMarker: 2026-08-13 — test-genie, scenario-auditor, scenario-completeness-scoring and tidiness-manager each hold part of the answer and no denominator is authored. Needs an obligation list before an observer is worth building.

topicCatalog.purpose: Judgment-based structural audit finding produced with a registered audit technique.
Universal-source bug intake written by any team through the report-bug skill and drained by bug-investigator.
Closed bug-investigation audit log with root cause, evidence, action taken, and remaining gaps.

planOfRecord.rationale: Strategic canon for scenario-qa: team plan-of-record overview, operating model, bug-report taxonomy, and three paired-doc-and-skill technique registries (investigation, audit, readiness).
planOfRecord.useFor: QA mission, member roster, work types, bug-report schemas, audit-technique applicability, investigation-technique applicability, future technique graduation

audit-lens-adoption/<skill-id>.comment: One-time gated adoption assessment for a steer audit-technique lens newly surfaced by the derived rotation query (ADOPTED vs NEEDS-REVIEW). Latest verdict per lens; prevents re-assessing the same lens every heartbeat. Adoption is from the existing catalog only — the auditor never invents a skill.

bug-inbox/<signal-type>/<slug>.comment: Universal-source intake (source_team: "*") — any team's members may write via the report-bug skill. The bug-investigator drains.

bug-investigation-report/<slug>.comment: Audit log of closed bugs; one entry per investigation. Drives technique-graduation work items on meta-self-improvement.

quality-auditor.lane: Perform structural quality audits using the audit-technique rotation and create execute backlog items with draft plans when findings are material.
safetyCriticalRules: Do not modify target scenario code directly.
Do not repeat a scenario/skill quality audit within seven days.

taskParameters.rotationQueryComment: The rotation is no longer a static list. It is the live set of steer-mode audit-technique skills whose detection has NOT yet graduated to a programmatic engine (programmaticHome unset). Skills auto-prune from the rotation the moment the skill-optimizer records their programmaticHome (e.g. screaming-architecture-audit graduated to test-genie:architecture). New steer audit-technique skills auto-appear and pass through the HEARTBEAT's one-time gated adoption assessment before being audited with.

bug-investigator.lane: Drain bug-inbox/* (universal-source — any team may write via the report-bug skill). Apply a registered investigation technique, identify root cause, take the smallest useful action, write a bug-investigation-report/<slug> audit-log entry on close.
safetyCriticalRules: Do not modify target scenario code directly; investigation produces evidence, not patches.

Do not write to bug-inbox/* (the producer side); the investigator only drains. The constraint is enforced by the topics.json output declarations and RESPONSIBILITIES.md, not by forbiddenWrites at the kind level.
Close every drained entry with a bug-investigation-report/<slug> audit-log entry — never silently delete a bug-inbox entry.

qa-contrarian.lane: Read peer scenario-qa member outputs (bug-investigation-reports, audits, readiness backlog) and write Swarm Manager review evidence/* plus Swarm Manager review state/* entries citing specific failure modes from docs/scenario-qa/{investigation,audit}-techniques/. Does not generate positive-action proposals. Also this team's shape sensor: hold the team against the target model's deviation catalogue and report deviations; never restructure.
safetyCriticalRules: Every challenge-note must cite a specific failure mode from a registered technique's PoR doc 'What the qa-contrarian watches for' section. Free-form challenges are forbidden.
Quiet heartbeats are valid; manufactured challenge is forbidden.
